name: Plant Field OS
tagline: A field-sales day for industrial reps: plan, installed base, audit
description: Structures the working day for field reps selling into industrial plants. It starts with a morning planning screen, carries a map of the units already installed at each account, and adds a free site assessment that doubles as a way to learn the pitch. Leadership gets one thin dashboard instead of a data dump.
author: Quantumcowgirl1
